story.en: The Divino Rostro leads Our Lady from the Old Shrine along Peñafrancia Avenue, P. Burgos, Elias Angeles and Iglesia Road to Porta Mariae and the Cathedral. The noon-to-18:30 replay follows the 2026 report. About 820,000 devotees attended that year; the two andas, bearers, marshals and dense crowd are illustrative representations.

sources.title: Naga Tourism: 2026 festival calendar
sources.note: Dated event dates and starts. Annual recurrence and depicted formations are illustrative; future arrangements may vary.

sources.title: Daily Tribune: 2026 Traslación
sources.note: Reports both images reaching Porta Mariae around 18:30, followed by Holy Mass, with about 820,000 devotees. The number drawn is illustrative.

sources.title: Bicol Mail: 2026 Traslación streets
sources.note: Reports a noon Shrine departure and the named street sequence. Iglesia Road is represented by the mapped Paz/Callejon segment adjacent to Porta Mariae; this mapping uses OSM geography.

sources.title: Project owner: Archbishop's Residence grounds
sources.note: On 2026-10-08 the project owner asked for no crowd in the Archbishop's Residence grounds; the roadside and Cathedral Grounds crowds stop at the mapped garden outline.
